timeline.message:
Fix SingleNodeDiscoveryStabilisesEvenWhenDisrupted

By increasing the voting duration in case of high
delays, to avoid the possible endless repetition
of voting rounds.

Fixes #89867
timeline.author: Iraklis Psaroudakis

timeline.body: If we aren't going to make `delayVariabilityMillis` bigger, could you extend this comment to mention that elections could take even longer than `delayVariabilityMillis` but in practice this is long enough to avoid bad collisions with very high probability?

timeline.body: I expect this will eventually fail because an election involves a couple of round-trips through the transport layer so should sometimes take as much as `4*delayVariabilityMillis` (possibly longer, I didn't look for other delays). However I've run over 30,000 iterations of this test without seeing a failure, so maybe I'm misunderstanding or maybe with this delay a bad collision just becomes very unlikely. So empirically this LGTM (except for a couple of nits).
